notes: Bubble overhaul: messages now expand so text is visible immediately (the v0.2/v0.3 bare-dot is why Brent never saw anything), inline reply to chat back, and a genuine STOP button on the bubble. New drive-anywhere toggle (default OFF) lets Hands drive any app incl. the system photo picker; password typing is now refused in code. Faster: adaptive polling (2s while driving, 15s idle) and a batch command that runs many steps in one round trip. Agent side: hands.py gains replies, find, tap-text, fill, scroll-find.
